name: Orbital Paladin Melchior Y
source: Nine years into an ongoing war between Earth and space colony governments, Wick Palmer is an eighteen-year-old pilot who's been entrusted with one of the most powerful mechas in the solar system. He joins the crew of the spaceship Nauvoo to guard a site responsible for the development of a new superweapon. Wick can get to know and form relationships with his fellow pilots. Soon, the enemy discovers their position and begins attacking. This game is a visual novel/action game hybrid.
translation: 地球与太空殖民地政府之间的战争已持续9年。威克·帕尔默是一名18岁的飞行员，受托驾驶太阳系最强大的机甲之一。他加入宇宙飞船“纳乌沃号”的船员，守卫负责研发新型超级武器的基地。威克可以了解并与其他飞行员建立关系。很快，敌人发现他们的位置并发动攻击。本作是视觉小说与动作游戏的混合作品。
